content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Cashless payment and telemetry software and hardware for vending operators, not metal payment cards sold to card issuers."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Manufactures and personalizes payment cards sold directly to banks and card issuers, matching the target's card-manufacturing business."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Banknote validators, cash-handling systems and currency security features sold to operators and central banks, not payment cards."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Runs transaction processing networks and outsourced IT for banks and merchants, a service model rather than card manufacturing."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Point-of-sale terminals, restaurant software and payment processing for merchants, not card production for issuers."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Makes industrial chemicals and sells ammunition, with no overlap with payment card manufacturing."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Paper protective packaging machines and kraft paper consumables for e-commerce and warehouses, unrelated to cards."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Consumer household disposables such as foil and bags sold through grocery retail, not card products to issuers."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Metal and plastic food and beverage containers and closures for packaged-goods makers, not payment cards."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Armored cash transport, ATM services and cash logistics for banks, a service business rather than card manufacturing."}]}
